scoring_justification: Recomputing migration barriers from raw NEB trajectories is computationally heavy and cannot run in the verifier; comparing reported energies and dimensionalities to paper gold is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold migration energies and dimensionalities for nine orderings
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 2 of the paper 'Effect of Cation Ordering on Oxygen Vacancy Diffusion Pathways in Double Perovskites' (Uberuaga & Pilania, Chem. Mater. 2015)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's Table 2 and verified against the reference solve.sh output; the minimum barrier for AR/BC is taken as 2.2 eV with 1D dimensionality.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported numbers; they are used as the hidden reference for scoring.

outputs.description: Migration energy (eV) and dimensionality (1D/2D/3D) for each of the nine cation orderings.

output_contract.notes: Migration energies are compared to the expected reference values with tolerance; dimensionality must match exactly.
